tasks.label: Typst: Build current document
args: $typst = Get-ChildItem "$env:LOCALAPPDATA\Microsoft\WinGet\Packages\Typst.Typst_*" -Recurse -Filter typst.exe | Select-Object -First 1 -ExpandProperty FullName; if (-not $typst) { throw 'Typst executable not found.' }; New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force -Path '${workspaceFolder}\build\typst' | Out-Null; & $typst compile --root '${workspaceFolder}' '${file}' '${workspaceFolder}\build\typst\${fileBasenameNoExtension}.pdf'

tasks.label: Typst: Watch current document
args: $typst = Get-ChildItem "$env:LOCALAPPDATA\Microsoft\WinGet\Packages\Typst.Typst_*" -Recurse -Filter typst.exe | Select-Object -First 1 -ExpandProperty FullName; if (-not $typst) { throw 'Typst executable not found.' }; New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force -Path '${workspaceFolder}\build\typst' | Out-Null; & $typst watch --root '${workspaceFolder}' '${file}' '${workspaceFolder}\build\typst\${fileBasenameNoExtension}.pdf'
